assignment: Final engineering completion: four authorised repairs

repair_1_per_skill_pools.original_failure: global commitment counting let one skill consume every slot; four of five skills delivered nothing
repair_1_per_skill_pools.root_cause: the capacity controller already counted reservations per capability and enforced a per-pipeline limit AND a separate global ceiling. Nothing called Capacity.reserve, so none of it was reachable.
repair: Qualification takes a capacity handle and reserves a slot per selected candidate, keyed by capability with idempotency_key=commit:<job_id>
Capacity.release_job(job_id) gives back every slot a settled job holds; idempotent, returns a count
the business cycle releases at reconcile
a job whose verification tier is unreachable is now failed explicitly instead of lingering in ACCEPTED holding a slot
repair_1_per_skill_pools.unconfigured_budget: a NOT_CONFIGURED refusal falls through to the existing global ceiling rather than stopping the shop; an explicit shutdown is operating_mode, which intake already enforces

repair_2_independent_csv_t2.original_failure: T2 refused every .csv deliverable; 34 of 100 contracts stopped at verification-eligibility
repair_2_independent_csv_t2.root_cause: worker and checker both parse with the standard library's csv, so a differential review using it would be Solvent reading its own output twice

dependency_exception.independence_evidence: clevercsv.read.reader.__iter__ constructs its own C Parser; it imports stdlib csv only for dialect-object interop (csv.get_dialect, csv.Dialect), never to parse a file
dependency_exception.why_alternatives_insufficient: no stdlib option is independent of the worker; pandas was the only other installable candidate and is vastly larger with unrelated surface
dependency_exception.declared_in: pyproject.toml [verification] extra, alongside the existing openpyxl and python-docx; imported lazily like them, so the zero-third-party architecture guard still holds

repair_2_independent_csv_t2.measured_effect: data-entry csv jobs now reach independent review; briefs with nothing recomputable still refuse and ask for a person, which is the pre-existing fail-closed design rather than a rubber stamp

repair_3_owner_signing.note: not attempted this round. The defect stands as measured at 3c7d6d0: harness.py mints an unsigned approval for the C2 delivery effect, so an Owner Channel makes the gate refuse every delivery including T1 work (0 of 100 with a key set). It needs a focused change to Action Gate authorisation plus the twelve-case acceptance matrix.

repair_4_startup_reconciliation.original_failure: a job killed during verification sat in VERIFYING for ever; nothing resumed, timed out or escalated it, and it kept its pipeline slot, so every crash permanently shrank the shop
repair_4_startup_reconciliation.existing_machinery_reused: runtime.reconcile already handled the hardest case -- an external action started and never settled is neither retried nor assumed successful, and the job is blocked on the owner. Extended rather than duplicated.
added: a sweep for jobs found in EXECUTING, VERIFYING or READY_FOR_DELIVERY after a restart: each is recorded as an incident and blocked on the owner
a sweep releasing pipeline slots held by jobs that are terminal, COMPLETE, or gone
repair_4_startup_reconciliation.deliberately_not_done: no automatic resume. Re-running a checker is safe in itself, but an interrupted job may also have had an external effect nobody wrote down, and carrying on with work already paid for is a judgement. This surfaces rather than guesses.
repair_4_startup_reconciliation.idempotent: a job already BLOCKED is left alone; a double restart reports nothing the second time
tests: blocked on the owner rather than quietly resumed
reconciling twice changes nothing the second time
a settled job's slot is returned
a job still owed work keeps its slot
repair_4_startup_reconciliation.why_not_verified: the brief asks for interrupted verification to be restored where safe and for crash tests at eleven named lifecycle points; neither was done
